newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Shares in Volvo rise on forecast, trade.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Volvo rise on forecast, trade.

text.p: Shares in Swedish automotive group AB Volvo rose on Tuesday, supported by a Monday forecast from Retail and Wholesale Institute HUI saying Swedish new car sales would rise steadily to the year 2003.
At 1400 GMT, the share was up 6.5 crowns, or 3.4 percent, at 197.5, while the Stockholm Stock Exchange's general index was up 1.38 percent.
The share also rose on trading ahead of the company redeeming shares worth 5.2 billion crowns, dealers said.
The redemption price will be determined as a 40 crown premium a share on top of the average of the three separate days on which the highest average price is recorded from May 13 to June 6.
"There is a lot of trading to push the price higher ahead of the redemption," said a trader with a Stockholm bank.
